items.name: number-field
items.title: NumberField
items.description: Numeric input with increment and decrement buttons (Base UI NumberField).
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Shift+Arrow takes the large step, Alt+Arrow the small step, dragging the label scrubs. For a bare `<Input type="number">` the UA spin buttons are hidden; prefer NumberField for steppers. `reserveError` keeps an error line reserved.
